description: Diagnose and manage hypertension in children and adolescents per the 2026 ISH Global Hypertension Practice Guidelines — percentile-based definitions under 16 years and adult thresholds from 16, measurement with child-validated devices and correct cuff, ABPM for confirmation, when to investigate for secondary causes (age <6, age 6–12 without obesity or family history, grade 2 without obesity, organ damage), lifestyle first for grade 1, when to start drugs, paediatric BP targets (<90th percentile; <130/80 from 16; CKD <75th or <50th with proteinuria), and when to refer. Use when a clinician asks "child BP high what next", "paediatric hypertension definition", "BP percentile in a 10-year-old", "when to start BP medicine in a child", "teenager with high BP", "secondary hypertension in children", or "BP target in a child with CKD". Source: Stergiou GS et al, 2026 ISH Global Hypertension Practice Guidelines, J Hypertens 2026 (DOI 10.1097/HJH.0000000000004451).
